**Unit system:** CGS by default. Constants are provided in the separate CGS constants sheet.

## Mechanics & Gravity

| Equation | Notes | Tools |
| --- | --- | --- |
| $F = ma$ | Force (dynes) | Force/Balance |
| $F_{\rm grav} = G\,\dfrac{m_1 m_2}{r^2}$ | Inverse-square | Force/Balance, Scaling/Ratio |
| $v_{\rm orb} = \sqrt{\dfrac{GM}{r}}$ | Circular orbit | Scaling/Ratio |
| $v_{\rm esc} = \sqrt{\dfrac{2GM}{R}}$ | Bound vs unbound | Energy, Scaling/Ratio |
| $P^2 = \dfrac{4\pi^2}{G(M+m)} a^3$ | Kepler (general) | Scaling/Ratio |
| $P^2 \approx \dfrac{4\pi^2}{GM} a^3$ | $M \gg m$ | Scaling/Ratio |
| $L = m v r$ | Circular orbit | Force/Balance |
| $E_K = \dfrac{1}{2} m v^2$ | Kinetic energy | Energy |
| $U_G = -\dfrac{GMm}{r}$ | Potential energy | Energy |
| $E = E_K + U_G$ | Total energy | Energy |
| $E_K \sim \dfrac{1}{2}|U_G|$ | Virial | Energy, Scaling/Ratio |

## Thermodynamics, Radiation & Light

| Equation | Notes | Tools |
| --- | --- | --- |
| $P = n k_B T = \dfrac{\rho k_B T}{\mu m_H}$ | Ideal gas | Force/Balance |
| $E_{\rm th} = \dfrac{3}{2} k_B T$ | Thermal energy | Energy |
| $c = \lambda \nu$ | Wave relation | Dimensional |
| $E_{\gamma} = h\nu = \dfrac{hc}{\lambda}$ | Photon energy | Dimensional |
| $F = \dfrac{L}{4\pi d^2}$ | Flux-luminosity | Scaling/Ratio, Model-Inversion |
| $F = \sigma T_{\rm eff}^4$ | Surface flux | Scaling/Ratio |
| $L = 4\pi R^2 \sigma T_{\rm eff}^4$ | Luminosity | Scaling/Ratio, Model-Inversion |
| $\lambda_{\rm peak} T_{\rm eff} = b$ | Wien's law | Scaling/Ratio, Model-Inversion |
| $\dfrac{\Delta\lambda}{\lambda_0} = \dfrac{v_r}{c}$ | Doppler shift | Model-Inversion |
| $E = 13.6\,\rm eV\left(\dfrac{1}{n_f^2} - \dfrac{1}{n_i^2}\right)$ | Hydrogen spectral lines | Model-Inversion |
| $P_{\rm rad} = \dfrac{1}{3} a T^4$ | Radiation pressure | Scaling/Ratio |

## Magnitudes & Angular Size

| Equation | Notes | Tools |
| --- | --- | --- |
| $m_1 - m_2 = -2.5\log_{10}\!\left(\dfrac{F_1}{F_2}\right)$ | Brightness ratios | Model-Inversion, Log rules |
| $\mu = m - M = 5\log_{10}\!\left(\dfrac{d}{10\,\rm pc}\right)$ | Distance modulus | Model-Inversion |
| $\alpha = \dfrac{s}{d}$ | Small angle | Scaling/Ratio |
| $\Omega \approx \pi\alpha^2$ | Solid angle | Dimensional |
| $d(\rm pc) = \dfrac{1}{p(\rm arcsec)}$ | Parallax | Model-Inversion |

## Stellar Structure & Scaling

| Equation | Notes | Tools |
| --- | --- | --- |
| $\dfrac{dM}{dr} = 4\pi r^2 \rho$ | Structure eqn | Dimensional |
| $\dfrac{dP}{dr} = -\rho\,\dfrac{GM(r)}{r^2}$ | HE | Force/Balance |
| $\dfrac{dL}{dr} = 4\pi r^2 \rho\,\epsilon$ | Energy gen | Dimensional |
| $\dfrac{dT}{dr} = -\dfrac{3\kappa\rho L}{16\pi a c T^3 r^2}$ | Radiative transport | Dimensional |
| $P_c \sim \dfrac{GM^2}{R^4}$ | Central pressure | Dimensional, Scaling/Ratio |
| $\rho_c \sim \dfrac{M}{R^3}$ | Central density | Dimensional, Scaling/Ratio |
| $T_c \sim \dfrac{\mu m_p G M}{k_B R}$ | Central temperature | Dimensional, Scaling/Ratio |
| $L \sim M^{3.5}$ | Mass-luminosity | Scaling/Ratio |
| $g \sim \dfrac{GM}{R^2}$ | Surface gravity | Scaling/Ratio |
| $E_g \sim -\dfrac{GM^2}{R}$ | Binding energy | Energy |
| $\mu = \dfrac{1}{2X + \tfrac{3}{4}Y + \tfrac{1}{2}Z}$ | Mean molecular weight | Model-Inversion |
| $P_{\rm deg} \propto \dfrac{\rho^{5/3}}{m}$ | Degeneracy | Dimensional |
| $P_{\rm tot} = P_{\rm gas} + P_{\rm rad}(+P_{\rm deg})$ | Total pressure | Force/Balance |

| Equation | Notes | Tools |
| --- | --- | --- |

| $t_{\rm ff} \approx \sqrt{\dfrac{3\pi}{32G\rho_{\rm avg}}}$ | Free-fall | Scaling/Ratio |

| Equation | Notes | Tools |

| Equation | Notes | Tools |
